name: Reply-to-DM Campaign
subtitle: DM the people who replied to any of your posts.
summary: Collects everyone who replied to your post (optionally only those who said a keyword like "interested"), keeps the ones with open DMs, and queues a templated DM campaign you approve on a card with a day-by-day sending plan. Ask for supporters only and it reads what each person wrote and keeps the genuinely supportive replies, which uses one more dataset op and a small AI cost. Past 100 recipients the campaign takes the first 100 in dataset order.
howToAsk: DM everyone who replied [keyword] to my post
Send my link to everyone who commented.
provide: the post link, optional keyword, your message ([name] fills in).
get: the collected audience, then an approval card with recipients and schedule.
launchPrompt: Collect everyone who replied to this post: [paste link]. Keep only the people who have DMs open (and only those who said [keyword], or drop that filter if I left it blank), then set up a DM campaign for my review with this message: [paste your message]. Keep the token [name] wherever their name should appear. If I say supporters only, read what each person wrote and keep only the genuinely supportive replies, and tell me how many were too unclear to judge.
